GUEST_LIMIT_REACHED.title: You've used all 3 free summaries!
GUEST_LIMIT_REACHED.explanation: Continued summarization requires a verified NEUST Peñaranda Off-Campus student account. Your existing summaries remain available.
GUEST_LIMIT_REACHED.recovery: Register as a student, check Student Verification, or log in to your verified account.

ACCESS_BUSY.title: Your summary requests are processing.
ACCESS_BUSY.explanation: Your available processing slots are already reserved. Failed requests do not consume a free summary.
ACCESS_BUSY.recovery: Wait for a running request to finish or cancel it before trying again.

ACCESS_SETUP_REQUIRED.title: Access checks are temporarily unavailable.
ACCESS_SETUP_REQUIRED.explanation: The student-access database setup is not available. No free summary has been consumed.
ACCESS_SETUP_REQUIRED.recovery: Contact the operator to complete the access-control migration, then try again.

TITLE_TOO_LONG.title: Shorten the document title.
TITLE_TOO_LONG.explanation: Document titles can contain up to 255 characters.
TITLE_TOO_LONG.recovery: Use a shorter title or leave the title blank.

REQUEST_EXPIRED.title: This request has expired.
REQUEST_EXPIRED.explanation: The recovery period ended and the retained source was removed.
REQUEST_EXPIRED.recovery: Return to the form and submit your source again.

TERMS_REQUIRED.title: Accept the terms to continue.
TERMS_REQUIRED.explanation: This action requires acceptance of the Terms and Conditions.
TERMS_REQUIRED.recovery: Review and accept the terms, then return to your request.

SUMMARY_INELIGIBLE.title: This summary cannot be used yet.
SUMMARY_INELIGIBLE.explanation: This action requires a completed summary with readable source text and a readable result.
SUMMARY_INELIGIBLE.recovery: Choose a completed summary or submit a new source.

RESULT_UNAVAILABLE.title: This result is not available.
RESULT_UNAVAILABLE.explanation: The result could not be found or is not accessible in your current session.
RESULT_UNAVAILABLE.recovery: Return to your summary history or submit a source in this session.

URL_TLS_FAILED.title: A secure connection could not be established.
URL_TLS_FAILED.explanation: LIGHT could not verify a secure connection to the source website.
URL_TLS_FAILED.recovery: Use another accessible source or paste text you can access.

URL_TOO_LARGE.title: This web source is too large.
URL_TOO_LARGE.explanation: The response exceeds LIGHT’s supported download size.
URL_TOO_LARGE.recovery: Use a smaller source or paste the relevant article text.

INPUT_EMPTY.title: Add a source to continue.
INPUT_EMPTY.explanation: There is no text or article link to summarize.
INPUT_EMPTY.recovery: Paste readable text, enter an article URL, or select a PDF or DOCX.

INPUT_INVALID.title: Check your input.
INPUT_INVALID.explanation: LIGHT could not read the submitted source fields.
INPUT_INVALID.recovery: Choose one source method and enter your source again.

INPUT_TOO_SHORT.title: More source text is needed.
INPUT_TOO_SHORT.explanation: The supplied text does not contain enough usable content for this request.
INPUT_TOO_SHORT.recovery: Include the complete passage or another relevant paragraph.

INPUT_TOO_LARGE.title: This source is too large.
INPUT_TOO_LARGE.explanation: The source exceeds the supported input limit shown on the form.
INPUT_TOO_LARGE.recovery: Shorten the pasted text or use a smaller source.

SOURCE_CONFLICT.title: Choose one source.
SOURCE_CONFLICT.explanation: More than one source method was submitted.
SOURCE_CONFLICT.recovery: Keep either a file, pasted text, or an article URL.

SETTINGS_INVALID.title: Check your summary settings.
SETTINGS_INVALID.explanation: One of the selected options is unavailable or unsupported.
SETTINGS_INVALID.recovery: Choose an available analysis mode, output format, and summary depth.

REQUEST_INVALID.title: This request could not be read.
REQUEST_INVALID.explanation: Some required request information is missing or invalid.
REQUEST_INVALID.recovery: Return to the form and submit your source again.

FILE_REQUIRED.title: Select a document.
FILE_REQUIRED.explanation: No file was received for the file source.
FILE_REQUIRED.recovery: Select a PDF or DOCX file and submit again.

FILE_UNSUPPORTED.title: This file format is not supported.
FILE_UNSUPPORTED.explanation: The file type or signature does not match a supported PDF or DOCX document.
FILE_UNSUPPORTED.recovery: Export the document as PDF or DOCX, or paste its text.

FILE_TOO_LARGE.title: This file is too large.
FILE_TOO_LARGE.explanation: The file exceeds the current upload or download size limit.
FILE_TOO_LARGE.recovery: Choose a smaller document within the limit shown on the form.

FILE_PAGE_LIMIT.title: This PDF has too many pages.
FILE_PAGE_LIMIT.explanation: The PDF exceeds the processing engine’s supported page limit.
FILE_PAGE_LIMIT.recovery: Upload a smaller selection of relevant pages.

FILE_CORRUPTED.title: This document could not be opened.
FILE_CORRUPTED.explanation: The document structure is damaged, incomplete, or malformed.
FILE_CORRUPTED.recovery: Open and export a fresh copy, or paste the document text.

FILE_ENCRYPTED.title: This document is protected.
FILE_ENCRYPTED.explanation: The document is encrypted or requires a password to read.
FILE_ENCRYPTED.recovery: If you have permission, export an unprotected copy or paste accessible text.

FILE_TEXT_UNAVAILABLE.title: No readable document text was found.
FILE_TEXT_UNAVAILABLE.explanation: LIGHT could not obtain readable text. The document may contain images or unsupported text encoding.
FILE_TEXT_UNAVAILABLE.recovery: Try a text-based copy or paste its text. An image-only document may need OCR first.

UPLOAD_INCOMPLETE.title: The upload did not finish.
UPLOAD_INCOMPLETE.explanation: Only part of the file reached LIGHT.
UPLOAD_INCOMPLETE.recovery: Check your connection, select the file again, and retry.

UPLOAD_FAILED.title: The file could not be received.
UPLOAD_FAILED.explanation: LIGHT could not store the uploaded file for processing.
UPLOAD_FAILED.recovery: Wait a moment, then select the file again and retry.

URL_INVALID.title: Check the article URL.
URL_INVALID.explanation: The link is not a valid HTTP or HTTPS address.
URL_INVALID.recovery: Copy the complete article address, including https://.

URL_UNREACHABLE.title: The website could not be reached.
URL_UNREACHABLE.explanation: LIGHT could not connect to the article website.
URL_UNREACHABLE.recovery: Check the address and try again later, or paste text you can access.

URL_TIMEOUT.title: The website took too long to respond.
URL_TIMEOUT.explanation: The article could not be retrieved within the connection time limit.
URL_TIMEOUT.recovery: Try again later, or paste the article text you can access.

URL_ACCESS_RESTRICTED.title: The website restricted access.
URL_ACCESS_RESTRICTED.explanation: The source website refused access or requires authorization.
URL_ACCESS_RESTRICTED.recovery: Open the source yourself and paste text you are allowed to use, or choose an accessible source.

URL_RATE_LIMITED.title: The website is limiting requests.
URL_RATE_LIMITED.explanation: The source website asked LIGHT to slow down.
URL_RATE_LIMITED.recovery: Wait before retrying, or paste the article text you can access.

URL_CONTENT_UNAVAILABLE.title: The article content is unavailable.
URL_CONTENT_UNAVAILABLE.explanation: The link did not return a readable article or the requested document.
URL_CONTENT_UNAVAILABLE.recovery: Check the article link, use another accessible source, or paste its text.

URL_UNSAFE.title: This address cannot be fetched.
URL_UNSAFE.explanation: LIGHT only retrieves sources from permitted public website addresses.
URL_UNSAFE.recovery: Use a public HTTP or HTTPS article URL, or paste the text.

DOCUMENT_EXTRACTION_FAILED.title: We could not read this document.
DOCUMENT_EXTRACTION_FAILED.explanation: The document was received, but extraction did not complete. The exact cause could not be determined.
DOCUMENT_EXTRACTION_FAILED.recovery: Try another copy or paste the document text.

CONTENT_UNREADABLE.title: More readable content is needed.
CONTENT_UNREADABLE.explanation: The source does not contain enough usable text for reliable processing.
CONTENT_UNREADABLE.recovery: Paste a complete readable passage, or choose a clearer document.

SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE.title: The source is no longer available.
SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE.explanation: The source file could not be found for this request.
SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE.recovery: Return to the form and select the file again.

NLP_NO_VALID_CANDIDATES.title: No usable summary passages were found.
NLP_NO_VALID_CANDIDATES.explanation: LIGHT could not identify suitable passages in the available text.
NLP_NO_VALID_CANDIDATES.recovery: Include complete sentences and relevant context, or choose a clearer source.

SUMMARY_QUALITY_FAILED.title: A reliable summary could not be produced.
SUMMARY_QUALITY_FAILED.explanation: The available text did not produce a summary that passed LIGHT’s quality checks.
SUMMARY_QUALITY_FAILED.recovery: Try clearer source text or include more relevant context.

WORKER_UNAVAILABLE.title: Processing is temporarily unavailable.
WORKER_UNAVAILABLE.explanation: LIGHT could not start or reach its processing service.
WORKER_UNAVAILABLE.recovery: Wait a moment and retry. Your source and settings can be reused where available.

TRANSLATION_RATE_LIMITED.title: Filipino translation is temporarily unavailable.
TRANSLATION_RATE_LIMITED.explanation: Filipino translation is temporarily unavailable because the translation service is busy. Your original summary is safe. Please try again later.
TRANSLATION_RATE_LIMITED.recovery: Wait until the indicated retry interval has passed, then retry manually.

TRANSLATION_TIMEOUT.title: Translation took too long.
TRANSLATION_TIMEOUT.explanation: The translation service did not respond in time. Your original summary is safe.

TRANSLATION_NETWORK_FAILURE.title: Translation is temporarily unavailable.
TRANSLATION_NETWORK_FAILURE.explanation: LIGHT could not connect to the translation service. Your original summary is safe.
TRANSLATION_NETWORK_FAILURE.recovery: Check your connection and try again later.

TRANSLATION_UNAVAILABLE.title: Translation is temporarily unavailable.
TRANSLATION_UNAVAILABLE.explanation: The translation service is temporarily unavailable. Your original summary is safe.

TRANSLATION_INVALID_RESPONSE.title: Translation could not be verified.
TRANSLATION_INVALID_RESPONSE.explanation: The translation service returned a response LIGHT could not verify. Your original summary is safe.

TRANSLATION_VALIDATION_ERROR.title: Translation could not be verified.
TRANSLATION_VALIDATION_ERROR.explanation: LIGHT could not verify a complete Filipino translation. Your original summary is safe.
TRANSLATION_VALIDATION_ERROR.recovery: Keep using your original English summary.

TRANSLATION_WORKER_FAILURE.title: Translation is temporarily unavailable.
TRANSLATION_WORKER_FAILURE.explanation: LIGHT could not complete translation processing. Your original summary is safe.

PROCESSING_TIMEOUT.title: Processing took too long.
PROCESSING_TIMEOUT.explanation: LIGHT did not finish within the processing time limit.
PROCESSING_TIMEOUT.recovery: Try a shorter source, or retry once processing is available.

PROCESSING_FAILED.title: This request could not be completed.
PROCESSING_FAILED.explanation: LIGHT encountered a problem, but could not determine its exact cause.
PROCESSING_FAILED.recovery: Return to your settings. If the problem continues, share the reference below with support.

PROCESSING_CANCELLED.title: Summary cancelled.
PROCESSING_CANCELLED.explanation: This request was cancelled before a result was completed.
PROCESSING_CANCELLED.recovery: Return to your settings to submit a source again.

RATE_LIMITED.title: Please wait before trying again.
RATE_LIMITED.explanation: Too many attempts were made in a short time.
RATE_LIMITED.recovery: Wait a moment before retrying this request.

AUTH_REQUIRED.title: Sign in to continue.
AUTH_REQUIRED.explanation: Your session no longer has access to this request.
AUTH_REQUIRED.recovery: Sign in again, then return to your summary.

ACCESS_DENIED.title: This request is not permitted.
ACCESS_DENIED.explanation: Your session could not authorize this action.
ACCESS_DENIED.recovery: Reload the form to refresh your session, then try again.

JOB_NOT_FOUND.title: This request is not available.
JOB_NOT_FOUND.explanation: The request could not be found in your current session.
JOB_NOT_FOUND.recovery: Return to your own summary history or submit a source in this session.

NETWORK_INTERRUPTED.title: The connection was interrupted.
NETWORK_INTERRUPTED.explanation: LIGHT could not confirm the latest request status. Processing may still be running.
NETWORK_INTERRUPTED.recovery: Check your connection, then check this request again.
